scope: Only test/41_forward_cnn_seed_ensemble may be created or modified. No production code, model, checkpoint, configuration, or other experiment is changed by this experiment, irrespective of the gate result.

background.experiment40_result: The shared CNN plus source-day readout failed: heldout four-fold macro final OCF delta was -0.807 and only 1/4 fold-pooled deltas was positive.
background.next_falsifiable_candidate: Test variance reduction from a fixed forward-CNN seed ensemble. Do not revisit the temporal mixing or attention hypothesis already rejected in experiment 26.
background.existing_single_seed: The existing forward CNN uses seed 42.

question: Does averaging independently trained forward-CNN predicted unit-by-time rates over the fixed seeds 42, 202 and 777 improve heldout Task2 leave-one-day-out decoding and full Poisson NLL over the otherwise identical seed42 CNN?

data.id_alignment: none; labels are used only for public source training and post-hoc validation scoring

folds.design: four leave-one-day-out folds for each mouse; all eight mouse-folds are fit independently
folds.session4_rule: session4 is retrained exactly like sessions 1-3, including every CNN seed and every MLP seed; historical session4 checkpoints or metrics are never substituted for newly paired arm results
folds.training_data: only train_trials from the three source days of the current fold; the identical pooled source-day per-glyph mean-count matrix is supplied to every CNN seed
folds.target_data_before_evaluation: no target-day response or label enters CNN rates or CNN/MLP fitting. The established unlabeled target-session normalizer for the MLP input may use target-day response marginals without labels; it never enters neural-response rates.
folds.target_labels: used only after prediction for recall, oracle, final OCF/top1, and true-glyph NLL evaluation

tune.purpose: fixed public reporting only; no seed, arm, epoch, weight, architecture, threshold, or hyperparameter selection

heldout.purpose: fixed public reporting subset for every preregistered decoding gate; both arms are evaluated

picture_subsets.historical_reuse_limitation: These picture IDs and leave-day protocols were reused in earlier experiments including 18, 24, 25, 26, 28, 34 and 40. Thus tune and heldout are not pristine or independent blind tests. Existing-CNN architecture, epochs, optimizer, MLP seeds/epochs, fusion weight, subset construction and the newly fixed CNN seed set are development choices rather than an independent confirmatory sample. No result-dependent selection is permitted here; results remain reused-development evidence and cannot support an independent-generalization claim.

fixed_cnn_contract.implementation: experiment 24 Encoder and training procedure as verified in experiment 40, with the CNN seed exposed as the only changed argument
fixed_cnn_contract.architecture: two Conv2d branches with kernels 3 and 7, SiLU/pooling, 384-feature concatenation, Linear(384, units*5), softplus rate plus 1e-6
fixed_cnn_contract.initialization: per-glyph pooled source-training mean rate with the historical inverse-softplus head-bias transform
fixed_cnn_contract.training_target: arithmetic mean over the three source days of per-glyph mean counts; identical for all three seeds
fixed_cnn_contract.training_loss: historical PyTorch poisson_nll_loss(log_input=False, full=False) on mean counts; the omitted target-dependent factorial constant does not affect optimization
fixed_cnn_contract.training_order: for each seed, torch.manual_seed(seed) precedes model construction and all seeded batch permutations; seeds are run in the fixed order 42, 202, 777
fixed_cnn_contract.source_days_and_architecture_matching: source days, source trials, training target, architecture, epoch count, batch size, optimizer and loss are exactly identical across seeds and arms

existing_cnn.rate: the seed42 predicted unit-by-time rate array

cnn_seed_ensemble.rate: elementwise arithmetic mean of the three independently predicted unit-by-time rate arrays, including the exact same seed42 array used by existing_cnn
cnn_seed_ensemble.forbidden_aggregation: no averaging of log-rates, logits, Poisson scores, observations, source-day observed prototypes, or target-day observations
cnn_seed_ensemble.score_construction: Poisson scores are computed once from the already averaged rate, not averaged across seeds

fixed_arms.seed42_reuse: Within every mouse-fold, seed42 is trained exactly once. The existing_cnn arm references that same in-memory predicted rate array and the ensemble averages that same array with seed202 and seed777; no second seed42 fit or prediction is permitted. Experiment 40 saved neither CNN rates nor checkpoints, so this run cannot honestly reuse its historical rates and does not claim cross-run rate reuse.
fixed_arms.seed_lock: The set and order [42, 202, 777] are frozen before seeing any experiment 41 result. Replacing, adding, dropping, or reordering seeds after seeing results is prohibited.

shared_mlp_and_fusion.implementation: test/25_rotating_sessions/run.py fit_mlp, retrained separately in every mouse-fold including session4
shared_mlp_and_fusion.training_rows: source-day single trials plus per-glyph means, with source-fitted session normalization as in experiments 25 and 40
shared_mlp_and_fusion.ensemble: equal arithmetic mean of the three raw logit matrices, then row_zscore
shared_mlp_and_fusion.arm_scores: four-repeat summed Poisson log-likelihood score excluding only candidate-independent constants
shared_mlp_and_fusion.fusion: 0.5 * row_zscore(mean MLP logits) + 0.5 * row_zscore(Poisson scores from the arm rate)
shared_mlp_and_fusion.pairing: one freshly trained shared MLP score matrix and the same target observations are used for existing_cnn and cnn_seed_ensemble within each mouse-fold

nll.definition: full Poisson negative log likelihood in nats per target trial and unit-by-time bin, including gammaln(k+1) = log(k!), using the four individual target repeats and their sufficient statistics; averaged over all 2748 target glyphs and all unit-by-time bins, then reported per mouse-fold
nll.evaluation_domain: the complete target day, not tune/heldout subsetting; the true public target glyph rate is used for evaluation only
nll.constant_rate: one rate per unit-by-time bin, constant over glyphs, fitted as the mean of all individual source-training trials in the same mouse-fold; no target-day data
nll.reported_deltas: cnn_seed_ensemble minus existing_cnn and cnn_seed_ensemble minus constant_rate; negative is better
nll.constant_rate_role: same-fold diagnostic control retained in every record and summary; it is not an additional advancement criterion

metrics.recall_at_1_and_32: rank of the true glyph in fused pre-assignment scores; larger score wins and exact ties are broken by smaller candidate index; reported separately from assignment outcomes
metrics.oracle32_ocf: for each row, take the deterministic top 32 candidates from fused pre-assignment scores and compute the maximum official OCF against the true target among those 32; purely diagnostic, uses labels only after ranking, and is not unique assignment or a submittable prediction
metrics.final: Hungarian unique_assignment independently for each arm on every complete 2748-row mouse-day fused score matrix, before tune/heldout subsetting; final_ocf is official OCF of assigned glyphs and final_top1 is exact assigned-ID accuracy
metrics.separation: oracle32_ocf, pre-assignment recall, and final unique-assignment metrics are separate fields and are never substituted for one another
metrics.aggregation: within a fold, pooled is the arithmetic mean of the two mouse values; macro is the arithmetic mean of the four fold-pooled values; per-mouse summaries are arithmetic means over that mouse's four folds. NLL uses the same fold-pooled/macro aggregation. Equal subset sizes make fold pooled equivalent to sample pooling.

implementation_reuse_and_integrity.experiment40_functions: Reuse experiment 40 repeat_statistics, full_nll, poisson_scores, cached_ocf and measure_subset without changing their definitions. Its in-memory OCF pair cache is shared across both arms and all folds in this process.
implementation_reuse_and_integrity.ocf_cache_disclosure: Experiment 40 did not persist its OCF cache, so no historical cache-value reuse is claimed. Experiment 41 starts an empty cache and reuses newly computed official OCF pairs within its own run.
implementation_reuse_and_integrity.historical_seed42_reproduction: As an implementation-integrity check, newly paired existing_cnn metrics and full NLL are compared with experiment 40 records for all eight mouse-folds; maximum absolute error must be <= 1e-5 or the run is invalid. This check does not replace any newly paired arm value and is not an advancement shortcut.
implementation_reuse_and_integrity.dependency_hashing: The final artifact manifest records SHA256 and byte size for this preregistration, run.py, experiment 40 run.py/results.json, experiment 25 run.py, experiment 24 run.py, and experiment 18 run.py, plus every output.

preregistered_advancement_gate.comparison: cnn_seed_ensemble minus the paired newly trained existing_cnn(seed42), using the same shared MLP in each mouse-fold
preregistered_advancement_gate.macro_final_ocf: four-fold heldout macro final_ocf delta must be strictly > 0
preregistered_advancement_gate.fold_consistency: at least 3 of 4 fold-pooled heldout final_ocf deltas must be strictly > 0
preregistered_advancement_gate.each_mouse: for each mouse separately, the four-fold mean heldout final_ocf delta must be strictly > 0 AND the four-fold mean heldout recall_at_32 delta must be >= 0
preregistered_advancement_gate.nll_macro: four-fold macro complete-target-day full NLL for cnn_seed_ensemble must be strictly lower than existing_cnn (macro NLL delta < 0)
preregistered_advancement_gate.nll_each_mouse: for each mouse separately, the four-fold mean complete-target-day full NLL for cnn_seed_ensemble must be no higher than existing_cnn (delta <= 0)
preregistered_advancement_gate.decision: advance is the logical AND of macro final OCF, fold consistency, both per-mouse decoding checks, macro NLL, and both per-mouse NLL checks. Any failure rejects advancement. No tolerance, post-hoc metric substitution, seed change, threshold revision, or selective fold omission is allowed.
preregistered_advancement_gate.production_rule_for_this_run: no production integration is performed in experiment 41 even if advance=true; a true gate only justifies a separate future review

outputs.initial_manifest_status: not_run; the complete run replaces it with hashed runtime dependencies and outputs
